mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS rising in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in unemployment rate above 4.5% triggers a negative feedback loop, reducing investor confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in <50% of triggered instances when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both personal consumption (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to outperform baseline by >10% in >70% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher interest rates reduce discount rates on equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceed 4.5% without a corresponding economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trajectory in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to rise by >2% in >80% of instances where INDPRO shows sustained upward momentum.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100 signals supply-side weakness, reducing corporate earnings expectations and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns remain positive in >50% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100 without a subsequent recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market participation (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) creates a virtuous cycle of consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns underperform by >15% in >75% of instances where both UNRATE and PAYEMS show upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle demand expansion (GDPC1 > 10,000), a decline in the federal funds rate below 4% intensifies accommodative monetary policy, synergizing with robust demand to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns fail to exceed baseline by >5% in >90% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 10,000 and FEDFUNDS drop below 4.0%.
